rows.en: (Gary-sensei called me in again...)
(It's remedial P.E. again, isn't it...)

Hey, \p.
You came...

Hello,
Sensei!
Looks like you've learned to say hello, at least.
But your P.E. is as hopeless as ever.

...Whatever.
Let's get right to your remedial P.E.!
Yes!!
rows.notes: Used in 10 places, possibly with other teachers, so kept neutral.

rows.en: Today I've got a special guest lined up.
A guest...

Hey, Yuuto!
Get out here!!
Hey, \p.

Y-Yuuto...
You've got remedial too?
Whoa, whoa, don't lump Yuuto in with you.
Then why is he here?
rows.notes: Subject restored: 'ja, doushite?' asks why Yuuto is here.

rows.en:
Yuuto couldn't stand watching what a slacker you are,
so he's joining you for this training.

So that's what it is...
Thanks, Yuuto.

Ha ha ha, well, let's give it our best.
Two heads are better than one, right?

Today we focus on endurance running!
Twenty 1500 m runs!
Fire yourselves up! Let the training begiiin!!!
Come on, that's only the fifth set!

Ten sets left!
We're halfway there!!
H-how is Yuuto not even winded...

Five sets left!
Focus, focus!!
You stuck it out. Good work.

I'm impressed,
\p.
rows.notes: 'minaoshita' = I think better of you now.

rows.en:
See ya.
Move your body every day, got it?!
I'm heading home too. Even I'm worn out.
Yeah, thanks to you too, Yuuto!

(Phew, it's not just Gary-sensei...
Yuuto's a crazy good athlete too...)
(Gary-sensei called me in agaaain...)
(It's gotta be remedial P.E. again...)
A guest?

K-Kagura-kun...
You've got remedial too?

Is that so...?
Thank you, Kagura-kun!

Today we focus on endurance running!
Ten 1500 m runs!
Come on, that's only the second set!

Five sets left!
We're halfway there!!
H-how is Kagura-kun so relaaaxed?!

One set left!
Focus, focus!!
Yeah, thanks to you too, Kagura-kun!

(Phew, it's not just Gary-sensei...
Kagura-kun's an amazing athlete too...)

...Took you long enough,
\p.
Huh, Gary-sensei... what's going on?
...I've been waiting for you.
Wh-what is it?
...Haven't you got something to report to me?

Where's this coming from all of a sudden...
Report? Not... really... anything? I think...
Sheesh... you're a hopeless guy, y'know!!
rows.notes: 'shou ga nee yarou' = hopeless guy; 'yarou' (guy) is what the female player objects to in c01031.

rows.en:
I heard the rumors, y'know...?
That you've been hanging out with that girl a lot...
rows.notes: 'ano onna' = 'that girl' (the player's love interest, unnamed); 'that woman' would sound odd for a classmate.

rows.en: Huh? Rumors?

Don't worry!
Even if the other teachers object,
I, for one, will be rooting for you!!
Me?
rows.notes: Female variant of 'na, nani ka?' after 'I've been waiting for you'; used in 18 places, kept short.

rows.en: I'm not a guy...

No use hiding it, no use hiding it!!
Even if the other teachers object,
I, for one, will be rooting for you!!

I heard the rumors, y'know...?
That you've been hanging out with that guy a lot...
rows.notes: 'ano otoko' = 'that guy'; labelled male variant though it reads as the female-player counterpart of c01027.

rows.en:
Hey, Protagonist.
So you finally showed up...
rows.notes: ext_gyr_* is an older copy of ext_gry_* that has the literal word 'shujinkou' (protagonist) where the later script has the player-name code. Translated as written; no \p added.

rows.en:
...Good.
You know why you were called in today, right?
That's right, you beansprout!

Answer me,
Protagonist!!
W-well then...
O-okay...

(He did twice as much exercise as me...
Is Gary-sensei immortal or what...?)
